retrievalProfile.description: A high-contrast black and white studio portrait featuring a dynamic, tilted subject pose framed by ultra-wide tracked sans-serif typography at the top and bottom edges.
triggerTerms: high contrast black and white fashion photography
excludeWhen: candid or outdoor settings are requested
script or serif typography is needed

recipe.visualDefinition: A square composition featuring a close-up, high-contrast black and white portrait of a woman with voluminous, textured 80s hair. The subject is tilted diagonally, creating a dynamic line from the bottom left to the top right. The image is framed by two lines of bold, widely spaced sans-serif text positioned at the extreme top and bottom margins.
coreVisualRelationships: Diagonal subject orientation against a neutral studio background
High contrast between deep black clothing and bright skin highlights
Symmetrical typographic framing at the vertical extremes
Textured, spiky hair silhouette contrasting with smooth skin tones
coreInvariants: Strict black and white color palette with no mid-tone color cast
Subject's head tilted at approximately a 45-degree angle

compositionAndHierarchy.subjectPositionAndScale: The subject occupies the central and lower-left regions, scaled to a medium-close-up portrait.
compositionAndHierarchy.visualAnchor: The subject's face and eyes, positioned in the upper-right quadrant of the central area.
compositionAndHierarchy.movementAndEyePath: The eye follows the diagonal tilt of the head from the bottom left shoulder up to the spiky hair, then moves to the horizontal text lines at the edges.
compositionAndHierarchy.negativeSpace: Significant neutral gray space in the upper-left and lower-right corners surrounding the subject.

colorSystem.saturationAndValueRelationship: Zero saturation; high value contrast between subject and background.

treatment.fill: Solid black or white depending on background

typographyAndGraphicLanguage.pairingStrategy: Single typeface used for both top and bottom text to maintain symmetry.

candidateDirections.reason: Matches the geometric 80s aesthetic and circular letterforms.
Provides the necessary geometric weight and sharp terminals.

twoStageComposition.backgroundInstruction: Generate a high-contrast black and white studio portrait of a woman with 80s spiky hair, wearing a black top, tilted at a 45-degree angle against a plain gray background. Leave clear space at the very top and bottom edges.
twoStageComposition.overlayInstruction: Add two lines of text in a bold geometric sans-serif font. One line at the top edge and one at the bottom edge. Set in all-caps with extreme tracking so the text spans the full width of the image.

verificationChecks: Is the image strictly black and white?
Is the text tracking extremely wide?
Is the font a bold geometric sans-serif?

mustRedesign: Do not use script or serif fonts
Do not use standard character spacing
postGenerationChecks: Check that text does not overlap the subject's hair or body.
Ensure the black levels in the clothing are deep and solid.
Verify that the tracking is consistent across both lines of text.
recipe.reuseFormula: High-contrast B&W portrait + diagonal pose + extreme-tracked geometric sans-serif framing.
